patthana23.44:1.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nasavitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.44:2.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naavitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.44:3.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naavitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … hetuyā ekavīsa.
